# NSCLC

```{r}
# ---- input ----
res <- readRDS("./NSCLC_res.rds")

# ---- processing ----
res_processed <- res %>%
  # 1) keep only significant rows with positive fold change
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05) %>%
  
  # 2) normalize PI within each ligand–receptor pair
  group_by(ligand, receptor) %>%
  mutate(
    sum_PI = sum(PI, na.rm = TRUE),
    PI_norm = ifelse(sum_PI > 0, PI / sum_PI, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-sum_PI)

# 3) summarize to sender (rows) × receiver (cols) by averaging normalized PI
sender_receiver_avg <- res_processed %>%
  group_by(lig_cell_type, rec_cell_type) %>%
  summarise(PI_avg = mean(PI_norm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = rec_cell_type,
    values_from = PI_avg,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# convert to numeric matrix
mat_res <- as.data.frame(sender_receiver_avg)
rownames(mat_res) <- mat_res$lig_cell_type
mat_res <- as.matrix(mat_res[ , setdiff(names(mat_res), "lig_cell_type"), drop = FALSE])

# ---- output: CSV ----
dir.create("./giotto", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
# write.csv preserves row names (sender cell types)
write.csv(mat_res, file = "./giotto/NSCLC.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

# BC

The results of Giotto of BC have Inf, so it is more complicate.

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# --- load ---
res <- readRDS("./giotto/BC_res.rds")

# Ensure PI is numeric (protects against accidental factors/characters)
res <- res %>% mutate(PI = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(PI)))

# --- quick DIAGNOSTICS (run these to see what's going on) ---
cat("\nPI summary BEFORE any filtering:\n")
print(summary(res$PI))

cat("\nCounts per LR pair BEFORE any filtering (top 10):\n")
print(res %>% count(ligand, receptor, name = "n_rows") %>% arrange(desc(n_rows)) %>% head(10))

cat("\nHow many rows survive p.adj <= 0.05 (and log2fc >= 0 if applied)?\n")
tmp_after_sig <- res %>% filter(p.adj <= 0.05)  # add , log2fc >= 0 if you want
print(nrow(tmp_after_sig))

cat("\nPI summary AFTER significance filter:\n")
print(summary(tmp_after_sig$PI))

# --- ROBUST PIPELINE ---
res_processed <- res %>%
  # keep only significant rows (add log2fc >= 0 if desired)
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05) %>%               # add: , log2fc >= 0
  # keep finite, positive PI only (prevents zero/NaN denominators)
  filter(is.finite(PI), PI > 0) %>%
  group_by(ligand, receptor) %>%
  # denominator per LR pair using finite PI
  mutate(sum_PI = sum(PI, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  # drop LR groups whose denominator is <= 0
  filter(is.finite(sum_PI), sum_PI > 0) %>%
  # normalize within LR
  mutate(PI_norm = PI / sum_PI) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-sum_PI)

cat("\nPI_norm summary AFTER normalization step:\n")
if (nrow(res_processed)) print(summary(res_processed$PI_norm)) else cat("No rows left.\n")

# If nothing survives, create an empty matrix to avoid NaN propagation
if (nrow(res_processed) == 0) {
  sender_receiver_avg <- tibble(lig_cell_type = character(), rec_cell_type = character(), PI_avg = numeric())
  mat_res <- matrix(numeric(0), nrow = 0, ncol = 0)
} else {
  # Summarize sender (rows) × receiver (cols); avoid NaN when all-NA
  sender_receiver_avg <- res_processed %>%
    group_by(lig_cell_type, rec_cell_type) %>%
    summarise(
      PI_avg = {
        v <- PI_norm
        if (!any(is.finite(v))) 0 else mean(v[is.finite(v)], na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = rec_cell_type,
      values_from = PI_avg,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    # just in case: replace lingering NaN with 0
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ replace(., is.nan(.), 0)))
  
  # Convert to numeric matrix
  mat_res <- as.data.frame(sender_receiver_avg)
  rownames(mat_res) <- mat_res$lig_cell_type
  mat_res <- as.matrix(mat_res[, setdiff(names(mat_res), "lig_cell_type"), drop = FALSE])
}

# --- save ---
dir.create("./giotto", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(mat_res, "./giotto/BC.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# --- extra sanity checks ---
if (length(mat_res)) {
  cat("\nRow sums (sender totals):\n"); print(rowSums(mat_res))
  cat("\nCol sums (receiver totals):\n"); print(colSums(mat_res))
}

```
